extension.description: A VS Code extension that lets you change text colors in Markdown previews.
markdownMojicolor.styles.bold.markdownDe: Color used to automatically color bold text in the Markdown preview. Leave blank to disable automatic coloring.
markdownMojicolor.styles.italic.markdown: Color used to automatically color italic text in the Markdown preview. Leave blank to disable automatic coloring.
markdownMojicolor.colorFiles.markdownDes: Absolute paths to JSON files loaded in order as additional color dictionaries. Later files override earlier definitions and built-in colors.
